documents.text: Patrick M. Regan Patrick M. Regan (born September 1, 1956) is a professor of Political Science and Peace Studies at University of Notre Dame. His research focuses on International Relations and Conflict Management. Regan was born in Dearborn, Michigan and is one of five children born to Michael and Susanne Regan. Regan attended Western Michigan University for his Bachelor's Degree, New York University for his Master's Degree and University of Michigan for his phD. He was also a member of the Peace Corps after receiving his undergraduate degree and travelled to Calcutta to work with Mother Theresa for six weeks.
